description: National Police Commission - The Delegation of Power by the National Police Commission
reasoning: This gazette notification deals specifically with the delegation of powers within the Sri Lanka Police Service by the National Police Commission. It focuses on law enforcement matters including appointments, promotions, transfers, disciplinary control, and dismissal of police officers. The content involves judicial/law enforcement administrative procedures and regulatory frameworks for police personnel management, making it a clear fit for Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes).
